templates.title: Email templates
templates.description: Upload HTML templates for compose. Global templates are available on every mailbox; mailbox templates only on that mailbox.
templates.empty: No templates yet. Upload an HTML file to get started.

validation.fileRequired: Choose an HTML file to upload.

systemTemplates.title: System templates
systemTemplates.description: Optional HTML for instance emails (invites, password reset, and recovery codes). If unset, Flaremail sends the built-in plain-text message. Use the listed tags in your HTML — they are replaced when the email is sent.
systemTemplates.subject: Subject: {{subject}}

revertConfirm.title: Revert to default?
revertConfirm.description: Remove the custom HTML for “{{label}}”? Flaremail will send the built-in plain-text email again.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Configure instance-wide security policies for every account.

tabAccess.label: Organization tab access
tabAccess.descIntendant: Who can view this Organization tab in Management. Only you can change this setting.
tabAccess.descOther: Who can view this Organization tab in Management. Only the recovery account can change this setting.

requireMfa.label: Require two-factor authentication
requireMfa.description: Accounts in scope must enable 2FA during activation or on their next sign-in.

requireRecoveryEmail.label: Require recovery email
requireRecoveryEmail.description: Every account must verify a recovery email during activation or on their next sign-in.

persistNoreply.label: Persist noreply outbound emails
persistNoreply.description: Keep copies of transactional emails from noreply@ in each domain's noreply Sent folder.

identitySelfServe.label: Identity self-serve
identitySelfServe.description: Allow accounts to create and edit identities on their primary mailbox. The organization default identity stays locked.

customNames.label: Allow custom names
customNames.description: Let users and managers choose a free-form From name. Admins and above can always use custom names.

defaultIdentity.label: Default identity
defaultIdentity.description: Live-linked template offered on every primary mailbox. Changes apply immediately for all accounts.

logsEnabled.label: Logs enabled
logsEnabled.description: When off, new logs are not stored. Existing logs remain readable until retention deletes them.

maxImportance.label: Max importance stored
maxImportance.description: Only logs with importance at or below this value are stored (0 is most important).

retention.label: Log retention
retention.description: How long logs are kept before the scheduled purge removes them.

oidc.title: OIDC clients
oidc.description: Register relying parties for SSO and machine-to-machine access.

editor.description: Configure redirect URIs, scopes, and consent for this relying party.
editor.name: Name
editor.homescreenHint: Where Cancel on the consent screen sends the user.
editor.saveFirst: Save the client first, then upload a profile picture.

secret.title: Client secret
secret.description: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again.

grantsDialog.title: Consent grants — {{name}}
grantsDialog.description: Revoke an account’s grant to force re-consent on the next authorize.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete OIDC client?
deleteConfirm.description: This revokes refresh tokens and consent grants for the client. Access tokens expire naturally.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Instance activity for the intendant and superadmins. Lower importance is more critical.
logs.emptyHint: Try widening max importance, clearing the date range, or choosing another type.

domainValidation.unavailableTitle: This domain is unavailable to your account
domainValidation.noRunYet: No validation run yet. Click Recheck to start one.
domainValidation.advisoryNote: Readiness is advisory only. It does not block sending, receiving, or mailbox management for this domain.
domainValidation.checksDescription: Required checks must pass for a healthy mail flow. Advisory checks are recommendations only.
domainValidation.selectRun: Select a validation run from the history to view check details.
domainValidation.logsDescription: Worker events recorded during the selected run.
domainValidation.historyDescription: Earlier runs stay available for comparison.

checking.label: Checking
checking.headline: Validation in progress
checking.description: DNS checks and the email loop are running. This page refreshes automatically until the run finishes.

healthy.label: Healthy
healthy.headline: Mail flow looks good
healthy.description: All critical and advisory checks passed. Your domain is configured correctly for sending and receiving.

unhealthy.label: Unhealthy
unhealthy.headline: Mail works, but something is off
unhealthy.description: Critical checks passed so mail can flow, but at least one advisory check failed. Review the recommendations below.

fail.label: Failed
fail.headline: Mail flow is not verified
fail.description: At least one critical check failed. Mail may not send or receive reliably until the issues below are fixed.

hint.skipped: Skipped because an earlier critical check failed.
hint.waiting: Waiting for this step to run.

mx.title: MX records
mx.summary: Inbound mail needs MX DNS records for the domain.
mx.description: Mail servers look up MX records to know where to deliver email for your domain. Without them, nothing can reach Flaremail.
mx.passHint: At least one MX record exists for this domain.
mx.failHint: No MX records were found. Configure Cloudflare Email Routing and wait for DNS to propagate, then recheck.

dmarc_rua.title: DMARC aggregate reports
dmarc_rua.description: DMARC lives at _dmarc.{{domain}}. The rua tag tells receivers where to send aggregate authentication reports. Pointing rua at {{postmaster}} keeps reports inside your platform.
dmarc_rua.passHint: A DMARC TXT record includes mailto:{{postmaster}} in its rua tag.
dmarc_rua.failHint: DMARC is missing or its rua tag does not include the postmaster address. Mail still flows; this is a best-practice recommendation.

loop_send.title: Outbound send
loop_send.description: Sends a validation message from {{noreply}} to {{postmaster}} through Cloudflare Email Sending. Confirms your domain is authorized to send and the outbound path works.
loop_send.passHint: Validation email was accepted for delivery from {{noreply}}.
loop_send.failHint: Sending failed. Check that Email Routing and Sending are enabled for this domain in Cloudflare.

loop_receive.title: Inbound delivery
loop_receive.description: Waits for the validation email to arrive at {{postmaster}} via your live routing setup. The run completes as soon as the message is received, or fails after a 10-minute deadline.
loop_receive.failHint: The validation email never arrived. Routing may still be propagating, or inbound rules may not be pointing to this worker.

logs.empty: No log events for this run yet.

sharedMailboxUsers.description: Control who can administer and use this shared mailbox, and how send personas work.
sharedMailboxUsers.notFoundBody: This mailbox may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.
sharedMailboxUsers.notSharedBody: Only shared mailboxes support user access management.

userAccess.title: User access
userAccess.description: Users granted here can read and send from this shared mailbox.
userAccess.adminNote: Admins and owners already have mail access to all mailboxes on their domains and do not need to be added here.

grants.emptyDesc: Grant a user access below so they can read and send from this mailbox.

managers.title: Managers
managers.description: Managers assigned here can administer user access for this shared mailbox.
managers.emptyDesc: Assign a manager below so they can manage user access on this mailbox.

identityPolicy.title: Identity policy
identityPolicy.description: Control which send personas appear when composing from this mailbox or elsewhere. From address always stays the active mailbox.
identityPolicy.allowPersonalDesc: When sending from this mailbox, offer identities from the sender's primary mailbox.
identityPolicy.exportDesc: Allow this mailbox's identities to be selected when sending from other mailboxes the account can access.

mailboxIdentities.title: Mailbox identities
mailboxIdentities.description: Name patterns and signatures owned by this shared mailbox.
